name: XWFlow Scene3 D
description: A flow lifted into 3D: an XWFlowCanvas laid on a tilted, glowing floor, with each step hovering at its own depth. Optional orbit by dragging, and zoom from the page's own controls.

depths.description: Height of each step above the floor in pixels; steps without one rise by order.

width.description: Plane size in pixels before the tilt.

tilt.description: Tilt of the plane: rotateX then rotateZ, in degrees.

nodeWidth.description: Card width of the floating steps.

ring.description: Draw the gradient ring under the middle of the flow.

orbit.description: Let people orbit the scene by dragging.

lanes.description: Floor bands, top to bottom, e.g. one per system.
